importSource.note: ADR-037 converter v0.18.0 corpus (wave-25, F69/F70/F71): the audit §4 text-hygiene + repo-hygiene wave. MS page-bottom furniture is dropped at source: parse_ms now skips the question-total footer in both printed word orders ('(Total for Question 7 = 6)' / 'Total marks for Question 7 = 10'), the paper-total line, the bare 'Total = N' fragment shape (2025-06 layouts), and the closing Pearson copyright block + its office continuation - 362 furniture lines across 245 corpus text blocks (153 parts, 50 slices; the G8 audit's 57-line estimate undercounted the class), so 50 mark points that served that furniture to learners are clean (44 footer tails + the three footer-only blocks). The three footer-only blocks were masquerading as a part's entire solution: 2021-01 2CR 7(d) (printed answer is a DRAWN displayed formula), 2025-06 2CR 7(c)(ii) (printed answer 'ethyl ethanoate' in a continuation row the row-parser mis-attributed) and 2025-06 1CR 9(d)(ii) (printed answer is two hand-drawn isomer structures) are now linked through the F47 MS-LINK-OVERRIDES ledger with eyeballed verbatim transcriptions (canaries C80/C81/C82); 7(d) previously served an EMPTY mark-point text. BEL U+0007 control chars (15 numbered-method-step strings) are normalized at source in clean_lines + the page_norm anchor index (F70), byte-identical to the exporter's stem strip. 57 orphan crop PNGs pruned (F71); C79 keeps the tree orphan-free. Canaries C77 (furniture-free corpus) and C78 (BEL-free corpus) pin the classes. Serving delta: markPoints on exactly 50 parts across 48 slugs, G-E1-matched against the filed disclosure 2026-10-26-wave25-sec4-hygiene.json; problemMd, solutionMd (authored layer), marks, choices and spec codes byte-identical everywhere else. Wave-15 UX doctrine governs under ADR-039 fix-and-disclose: best learner experience, values never invented. 54 official sets (16x1C + 16x2C + R-variants), 477 questions, 2607 parts, all spec-tagged.
